Frequently asked questions

What did philosophers say about affirmation?

They approached affirmation from ethics, metaphysics, politics, and lived practice. The passages below show several of those angles in compact form.

Where can I find philosophy quotes about affirmation?

This archive page is organized for that search intent: verified English quotations, with links to thinkers and related themes.

How should I read these quotations?

Read the sentence first, then check school and source. A quotation is a doorway into an argument, not a substitute for the surrounding text.

  1. Amor fati: let that be my love from now on!
    Friedrich Nietzsche
    Philosophy of Life
  2. This life as you now live it and have lived it, you will have to live once more and innumerable times more…
    Friedrich Nietzsche
    Philosophy of Life
  3. Every day is a good day.
    Yunmen Wenyan
    Zen Buddhism
  4. Would you have this life again? — Well then! Once more!
    Friedrich Nietzsche
    Proto-Existentialism
  5. Courage is the self-affirmation of being in spite of the fact of nonbeing.
    Paul Tillich
    Existential Theology
